title: Attempted-speech phoneme-sequence decoding
disposition_reason: The assigned registered-runtime artifact is a historical declaration with empty entrypoints and unscored full45 semantics; its referenced authoring paths are not present in this task delivery. It does not deliver a usable phoneme evaluator or qualified programme. The adjacent NEURAL-014 implementation is a different calibration protocol and cannot silently substitute.

scientific_target.question: How accurately can a precommitted neural decoder predict attempted-speech phoneme sequences in later T15 sessions without query labels or a query-time language-model correction?
scientific_target.known_answer: The source phoneme sequence for each retained attempted-speech trial, including the declared word-boundary symbol and edit denominator policy.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Publicly labeled train/validation HDF5 members of the author Dryad v5 T15 release; transcript/phoneme fields must be operator-private for query trials. Official competition test targets are a distinct exposure regime.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete attempted-speech trial feature time series from a later session.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One biological participant T15; 45 date-coded sessions are repeated measures, not 45 people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Later-session generalization within one participant on a prospective public-development split; not the paper deployed online decoder or a population result.
exclusions: Clinical speech efficacy or new-person generalization
Paper WER or competition performance inferred from local PER
Completed scoring inferred from a historical source_complete status

inputs: Source-defined 512 ordered intracortical features per 20 ms step, with full trial length and fixed feature provenance; authentic feature-axis/calibration verification still required.
Permitted labels only for earlier training/development sessions; frozen decoder state for later inference.
forbidden_inputs: Query transcriptions, phoneme sequences, sentence identifiers or answer-bearing source paths
Query-label calibration under the zero-calibration task
Undeclared pretrained language exposure or cross-split repeated sentence leakage
observation_contract.case_identity: Historical manifest declares all 45 sessions, split 27 training/9 development/9 query, with pointwise query semantics; no authenticated complete query-ID manifest or retained trial count is delivered.
observation_contract.split: Chronological 27/9/9 session policy is declared. Repeated sentence identities must be grouped across partitions with a frozen precedence rule before use; do not borrow NEURAL-014 calibration permissions.
observation_contract.coverage: One participant/all 45 declared sessions; delivered manifest says full prepared packet required and metric_computed=false. Published trial totals require reconciliation rather than selecting a convenient subset.

primary.name: later_session_macro_phoneme_error_rate
primary.aggregation: For each of nine later sessions, sum token edit distances and divide by that session reference token count; then equal-session mean. Freeze vocabulary and boundary-token denominator before execution.
primary.rationale: Measures a genuine withheld sequence target, with session weighting that avoids long sessions silently dominating.

secondary: Pooled edit counts and token denominators, insertions/deletions/substitutions
Per-session PER, sequence exact-match and complete trial coverage
Neural-shuffle and zero-feature degradation plus fixed language-only prior
Latency, fit cost and declared calibration-label exposure

nuisance_controls: Group identical normalized text across train/development/query, not only trial IDs.
Keep 512-feature ordering, source preprocessing and any normalization exposure explicit.
Separate duration/language priors from neural sequence information.
Use session-level summaries without claiming independent biological replications.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all nine later-session outcomes and descriptive paired session contrasts within T15. Session resampling, if added, is conditional repeated-measure uncertainty and cannot create a population confidence interval from one person.
evaluation.failure_policy: Missing or duplicate trial IDs prevent a complete score. Empty predicted sequences are valid deletions; nonfinite inputs, invalid vocabulary or unbounded outputs are malformed. Preserve all retained source trials and explicit exclusion reasons.
